_comment: Echo Realm final density. The interpolated+squeeze wrapper is NOT optional: noise is only sampled on a 1x2-block cell grid, and without minecraft:interpolated each cell keeps its own constant density, which renders as the stair-stepped terraces seen in-game. Vanilla overworld/final_density applies exactly this chain (blend_density -> interpolated -> squeeze); blend_density is omitted here because the Echo Realm never blends against an old-world region.
